crosscutting.title: Menu, toolbar, hotspots and keyboard
crosscutting.finding: Original menu hierarchy is freshly recovered from serialized records and metadata bindings. Toolbar/office events are inventoried, but numeric event slots do not by themselves identify Click/KeyDown meanings.
crosscutting.next_evidence: Trace each bound event, array-index switch and keyboard branch; record the current player path separately from missing menu access, missing options, missing functionality and unresolved original behavior.

crosscutting.title: Screens, layouts, buttons and window lifetime
crosscutting.finding: All 2605 known control property streams and all 84 roots are structurally bounded. The MDI root omits the normal Form-class byte and begins directly with ClientLeft. Opaque object/reserved marker meanings remain unresolved; there are 537 picture properties.
crosscutting.next_evidence: Resolve opaque marker meanings and unsupported encodings outside the known inventory; runtime values/assignments and keyboard/focus still require comparison.

crosscutting.title: Timelines, automatic triggers and ordering
crosscutting.finding: Module1/Module2 and all known serialized timers are inventoried. Direct P-code thunks and object-reference sites are indexed; dynamic calls and state aliases are not a complete scheduler graph.
crosscutting.next_evidence: Label callback slots, resolve timer enable/interval writers and caller continuation; observe actor/weekly/monthly/yearly order, stalls, simultaneous events and window drag.

crosscutting.title: Globals, members, arrays and native RNG
crosscutting.finding: Operand references remain indexed with unqualified member receivers kept explicit. The new RNG map resolves 310 native random draw sites and one startup seed site. This is a callsite inventory, not whole-session draw order.
crosscutting.next_evidence: Classify remaining receiver aliases and executed RNG paths; compare native seeds and paired saved sessions.

crosscutting.title: Persistence and migration
crosscutting.finding: All 130 native read/write record templates now pair their 448 field slots and array ranks, covering 447 distinct members and 40 loops. Modern numbered JSON slots work; native GD2 interoperability remains unsupported.
crosscutting.next_evidence: Validate Variant subtypes, loop cardinalities, modern meanings and native encoding against genuine GD2 fixtures before enabling compatibility.

crosscutting.title: Artwork, icons, patches and external files
crosscutting.finding: The official LZH has 45 files and three directories, with lengths and CRC16s verified. All 422 BMP/GIF property imports match bytes or decoded pixels. There are 114 ICO properties and one CUR; 82 root-icon exports are checked separately. Exhaustive dynamic image use remains unverified. The separate PE resource tree is also inventoried: one icon, one icon group and one version payload.
crosscutting.next_evidence: Resolve the remaining control ICO/CUR and dynamic assignment uses; pair rendered screens with the original runtime.

crosscutting.title: Original audio and music
crosscutting.finding: Five original WAVs are recovered. Existing native effect callsites remain wired; in-game Sound On/Off now controls the source effect dispatcher independently of community music. Open.wav has no established trigger; Bakuhatu.wav has a dispatcher branch but no recovered caller.
crosscutting.next_evidence: Keep unused/unproven triggers explicit; validate audio timing and replacement on the original runtime rather than assigning invented cues.

crosscutting.title: Tables, formulas and importer coverage
crosscutting.finding: Existing importers recover catalog families from the initialization procedure at 009F651C; metadata/procedure/reference inventory starts from the original, not the current catalog model. Raw members retain unknown semantics.
crosscutting.next_evidence: Reconcile every initialization assignment/table/helper with a schema or explicit unknown; compare source row counts/types with importers and model fields. Existing imported rows are not a denominator for all original tables.

crosscutting.title: Archive and original runtime acceptance
crosscutting.finding: The official archive and exact supported PE are recovered. A disposable original installation with VB6 runtime is prepared, but Wine11 exits with host SIGSEGV before a usable game window; a bounded strace confirms the failure. All 245 paired workflow scenarios remain pending.
crosscutting.next_evidence: Use a working original Windows runtime for the 245 comparisons, native focus/timing acceptance and genuine GD2 fixtures. The failed Wine run is not an acceptance pass.

gaps.task: Official archive inventory/import verification is complete. Original runtime acceptance remains blocked on this host by Wine SIGSEGV; execute all 245 paired scenarios on working Windows before claiming complete coverage.

Poaching is implemented and regression-tested. Compare the four native forms, timer delivery/retained controls, automatic offers and the unresolved empty-roster scratch boundary on the original runtime.

Missing backup/poaching/direct-game access and sound/graphics/number options are restored. Remaining original menu grouping, exact enable/visibility rules, About and utility access still need reconciliation.
Classify dynamic dispatch targets, timer interval/enable writers, scheduler order and actor/callback persistence; direct-call graph alone is incomplete.

All 130 native record templates have paired member/rank references (448 field slots); 310 RNG draw sites and one seed site are mapped. Finish field meanings/types/cardinalities and genuine GD2 cross-load tests; compare whole-session native seed/draw ordering.
Backup purchase, source ownership/reset/persistence, virus outcomes, office animation and saved continuations are implemented and tested. Paired original runtime acceptance remains pending.

All 2605 control streams and all 84 roots are structurally bounded. Resolve meanings of opaque zero-object/reserved 98/99 markers and investigate unsupported encodings outside the known inventory; consumed bytes are not understood behaviour.

All 45 archive files and 422 imported raster properties are verified, with 82 root icons. Resolve remaining control ICO/CUR usage, dynamic assignments and unproven audio triggers; imported files are not exhaustive handler coverage.
Graduate/renewal artwork aliases are corrected to fGMKeiyakuS/fGMSKoyouKz. Native runtime presentation comparison remains pending.
Resolve utility forms and fGMZishaNet data initialization/writers before exposing guessed behavior.
Verify all presented screens, selections, button glyphs, graph blocks, bilingual patches, window retention, focus and drag-time suspension on the original Windows runtime.

menu_dispositions.label: Menu
menu_dispositions.disposition: Menu organization: Game follows original New Game, Save, Load and Quit ordering/separators. A separated Back to Title entry retains port navigation.

menu_dispositions.label: New game
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Game > New Game opens a draft without replacing the company until start; cancelling returns to the current company. The title-screen route also remains available. Compact setup and Enter confirmation are implemented; native Windows font/IME acceptance remains pending.

menu_dispositions.label: Separator
menu_dispositions.disposition: Separator: decorative menu divider; no action or gameplay is expected.

menu_dispositions.label: Save game
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Game > Save Game opens the numbered save picker. OpenGDS2 saves JSON; native GD2 compatibility is missing.

menu_dispositions.label: Load game
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Game > Load Game opens the numbered load picker. OpenGDS2 loads JSON; native GD2 compatibility is missing.

menu_dispositions.label: Separator
menu_dispositions.disposition: Separator: decorative menu divider; no action or gameplay is expected.

menu_dispositions.label: Exit game
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Game > Quit closes the application. Native unload/confirmation equivalence remains pending.

menu_dispositions.label: Actions
menu_dispositions.disposition: Menu organization: Actions uses the original grouping without Extra Actions. Development-room and secretary clicks retain their original access routes.

menu_dispositions.label: Company development
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Actions > Company development contains Public relations, Genre research and Expand production in original order; the three UP toolbar actions remain.

menu_dispositions.label: Public relations
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Actions > Company development > Public relations, or the Public relations UP toolbar button, opens the activity confirmation.

menu_dispositions.label: Genre development
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Actions > Company development > Genre research, or the Genre research UP toolbar button, opens the activity confirmation.

menu_dispositions.label: Production expansion
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Actions > Company development > Expand production, or the Expand production UP toolbar button, opens the activity confirmation.

menu_dispositions.label: Separator
menu_dispositions.disposition: Separator: decorative menu divider; no action or gameplay is expected.

menu_dispositions.label: Recruit employees
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Actions > Hire Employees, or the recruitment toolbar button, opens recruitment.

menu_dispositions.label: Poach employees
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Actions > Poach employee opens the source-eligible target roster and timed negotiation. Automatic defensive offers, donations, contract changes and saved outcomes are implemented; native runtime comparison remains pending.

menu_dispositions.label: Separator
menu_dispositions.disposition: Separator: decorative menu divider; no action or gameplay is expected.

menu_dispositions.label: Secretary settings
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Actions > Secretary policies opens the secretary settings window.

menu_dispositions.label: Change secretary
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Actions > Hire secretary, or the secretary toolbar button, opens secretary hiring/change.

menu_dispositions.label: Separator
menu_dispositions.disposition: Separator: decorative menu divider; no action or gameplay is expected.

menu_dispositions.label: Visit bank
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Actions > Bank, or the bank toolbar button, opens the bank window.

menu_dispositions.label: Buy development computer
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Actions > Development Computers, or the computer toolbar button, opens computer purchasing.

menu_dispositions.label: Buy backup device
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Actions > Buy backup device implements the one-time gameplay purchase and virus-protection flag. Modern save-file .bak recovery is a separate feature.

menu_dispositions.label: Acquire hardware license
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Actions > Hardware Licenses, or the license toolbar button, opens license purchasing.

menu_dispositions.label: Buy technology
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Actions > Technologies, or the technology toolbar button, opens technology purchasing.

menu_dispositions.label: Go out
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Actions > Go out contains the original three direct game choices. The casino facility route also remains available. Existing ownership/coins/modal guards are retained; exact native menu gating remains pending.

menu_dispositions.label: Go horse racing
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Actions > Go out > Horse racing, or the casino facility selector. Existing catalog/funds/ownership/modal guards still apply.

menu_dispositions.label: Play poker
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Actions > Go out > Poker, or the casino facility selector. Existing ownership/coin/modal guards still apply.

menu_dispositions.label: Play blackjack
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Actions > Go out > Blackjack, or the casino facility selector. Existing ownership/coin/modal guards still apply.

menu_dispositions.label: Information
menu_dispositions.disposition: Menu organization: Information contains Staff, Products, Top 100, Platforms, Our consoles and Time records in the comparison screenshot order. The extra Game details submenu is removed.

menu_dispositions.label: All staff information
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Information > Staff, or the staff toolbar button, opens the implemented staff roster. The original handler uses local dispatch whose target is unresolved in the direct-call graph; exact native equivalence remains unverified.

menu_dispositions.label: Own released games
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Information > Products, or the products toolbar button, opens the implemented own-product list. Exact original local-dispatch behavior remains unverified.

menu_dispositions.label: Top 100 cumulative sales
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Information > Top 100, or the sales-ranking toolbar button, opens the implemented ranking report. Exact original local-dispatch behavior remains unverified.

menu_dispositions.label: Currently released hardware
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Information > Platforms opens the released-hardware report.

menu_dispositions.label: Separator
menu_dispositions.disposition: Separator: decorative menu divider; no action or gameplay is expected.

menu_dispositions.label: Own released hardware
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Information > Our consoles opens the own-hardware report when its state is available.

menu_dispositions.label: Separator
menu_dispositions.disposition: Separator: decorative menu divider; no action or gameplay is expected.

menu_dispositions.label: Reach-time rankings
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Information > Time records opens the reach-time records view.

menu_dispositions.label: Windows
menu_dispositions.disposition: Menu organization: Windows contains Office, Company and Other windows; the latter lists numbered current child-window titles with the front window checked.

menu_dispositions.label: Visual window
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Windows > Office reopens the office window. Exact original show/hide behavior remains unverified.

menu_dispositions.label: Tool window
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Windows > Company reopens the company window, the comparison for original fGMInfo. Exact original page/tool-window behavior remains unverified.

menu_dispositions.label: Other windows
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Other windows builds a numbered child-window list and reopens the selected window. The original entry has no explicit bound handler (native MDI bookkeeping); exact Windows runtime focus behavior remains unverified.

menu_dispositions.label: Settings
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: in-game Settings exposes the original Sound, Graphic enlargement and Number display submenus. Title-screen Settings retains community music and language preferences.

menu_dispositions.label: Sound
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Sound On/Off controls effects and the optional community music together. Separate channel switches and volume controls are an accepted port extension.

menu_dispositions.label: Sound on
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Sound > On enables both effects and community music. Independent channel controls remain available.

menu_dispositions.label: Sound off
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Sound > Off mutes both effects and community music. Independent channel controls remain available.

menu_dispositions.label: Graphic enlargement
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Settings > Graphic enlargement selects Normal/Enlarged office graphics. The saved choice uses native-size pixels or 2x pixels with a bounded scroll viewport.

menu_dispositions.label: Normal size
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Settings > Graphic enlargement > Normal restores native office resolution and clears the visible scroll position.

menu_dispositions.label: Enlarged size
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Settings > Graphic enlargement > Enlarged doubles office pixels and preserves office input-coordinate mapping. Native panning/focus acceptance remains pending.

menu_dispositions.label: Number display
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Settings > Number display selects Japanese or comma-separated thousands grouping across the UI; the choice is stored in company saves.

menu_dispositions.label: Japanese large-number grouping
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Number display > 100万0000 uses Japanese four-digit grouping, matching the original option caption. Modern Int64 values additionally support 京.

menu_dispositions.label: Thousands grouping
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Number display > 1,000,000 uses comma-separated three-digit grouping, matching the original option caption.

menu_dispositions.label: Help
menu_dispositions.disposition: Menu organization: Help > Game help opens the implemented topic viewer. Version information/About is restored in the separate About dialog.

menu_dispositions.label: Help topics
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Help > Game help, or the help toolbar button, opens the five-topic original Help viewer.

menu_dispositions.label: Separator
menu_dispositions.disposition: Separator: decorative menu divider; no action or gameplay is expected.

menu_dispositions.label: Version information
menu_dispositions.disposition: Available: Help > About / Version opens the compact AboutWindow corresponding to fMainAbout, with local original artwork/icon, current port version, original copyright and interactive Kairosoft website controls. See [fidelity follow-ups, step 4](fidelity-followups-20261017.md#step-4-aboutversionwebsite-dialog); native browser/pixel acceptance remains unrun.
